title: Auth Control Plane invite accept request (v1 wire format)
description: Body of an invite accept call. The token is an org_invite_token credential (contracts/auth/v1/credential-classes.json): bound to one invitee and one organization, stored hashed, valid for this purpose only. The caller supplies no address.

schema_version.description: Contract identifier. A reader MUST reject an unrecognised value (G-26: unknown denies).

token.description: The org_invite_token credential: 32 lowercase hex characters, a dot, 64 lowercase hex characters.
